GUN CLUB ELITE FOOTBALL CLUB INC.
Through the Endeavors of a few men, many will prosper.
Leadership, Dedication and Discipline

P__ ■ - IIComprised of Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office Law Enforcement and Corrections Deputies
Gun Club Elite Football Club Inc. was formed "To promote the sport of competitive flag football
through scheduled competitions, thereby developing team/organizational spirit, sportsmanship
and community outreach." It's our goal as a team to be exceptional on and off the field. On the
field we sacrifice our own time and financial means to sustain our club. We as a team have
committed to practicing hard and playing harder, to be gracious in winning and maintaining
dignity in losing.
Off the field it's our sincere goal as a team, to be committed as supporters of charities, special
events and organizations such as the Heart Association, Cancer Association by way of
participating in events and team financial contributions. We are more than just a flag football
team; we are Gun Club Elite Football Club Inc. We will make our mark on and off the field.
All Donations are greatly appreciated, and tax deductible
Donations allow us to compete in statewide tournaments such as the Pig Skin Classic in Orlando
which benefits the Special Olympics or Battle of The Badges @ Sun Life Stadium where the top
Law Enforcement teams compete for bragging rights. It allows us to achieve the goals we have
in being supporters of other organizations and charities off the field and the best on the field.
Checks made payable to Gun Club Elite Football Club Inc.
